faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District & Sessions Judge, Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District & Sessions Judge, Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 32 vacancies: 8 Gate Keeper, 6 Chowkidar, 18 Parking Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District & Sessions Judge, Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed post-wise application forms on pages 4 to 6 of this notice and on chandigarh.dcourts.gov.in) and send it to The District and Sessions Judge, Chandigarh, New District Court Complex, Sector 43, Chandigarh, by in the office, by post or courier; must be received by 05:00 pm of 16.11.2026, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 37 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: OBC 3 years, SC 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per rates fixed by the Deputy Commissioner, U.T., Chandigarh from time to time. for Gate Keeper, As per rates fixed by the Deputy Commissioner, U.T., Chandigarh from time to time. for Chowkidar, As per rates fixed by the Deputy Commissioner, U.T., Chandigarh from time to time. for Parking Attendant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passed middle standard examination and knowledge of Hindi/Punjabi. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Hindi/Punjabi required. Must be a citizen of India, Nepal or Bhutan, an eligible Tibetan refugee or a person of Indian origin as listed. Categories (b) to (e) need a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India before appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be rejected at any stage; if erroneously appointed, removed without notice.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview/Skill Assessment Test. Selection purely on interview/Skill Assessment Test. Date of interview/Skill Assessment Test and list of eligible candidates to be uploaded on the official website under the recruitment tab. Bring at least one photo ID proof and original testimonials to the interview/Skill Assessment Test.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis initially for a period of 89 days, which may be extended further. Contract service will not bestow any claim for regular appointment.
